mapper.select: SELECT o.approved_order_id AS approved_order_id, r.outbound_request_id AS outbound_request_id, o.instruction_no AS instruction_no, r.outbound_date, r.approved_status, p.partner_name AS partnerName, m.member_name AS driver_name, w.warehouse_id AS warehouse_id, w.warehouse_name AS warehouseName FROM OutboundRequest r LEFT JOIN OutboundOrder o ON r.outbound_request_id = o.outbound_request_id LEFT JOIN Member m ON r.member_id = m.member_id LEFT JOIN Partner p ON m.partner_id = p.partner_id LEFT JOIN Warehouse w ON r.warehouse_id = w.warehouse_id ORDER BY r.outbound_date DESC

SELECT o.approved_order_id AS approved_order_id, o.outbound_request_id, o.order_status, r.outbound_date, r.approved_status, p.partner_name AS partnerName, d.dispatch_id AS dispatch_id, d.car_id AS car_id, d.car_type AS car_type, d.driver_name AS driver_name, d.dispatch_status AS dispatch_status, d.loaded_box AS loaded_box, d.maximum_box AS maximum_box, r.warehouse_id AS warehouse_id, w.warehouse_name AS warehouseName FROM OutboundOrder o LEFT JOIN OutboundRequest r ON o.outbound_request_id = r.outbound_request_id LEFT JOIN Dispatch d ON d.approved_order_id = o.approved_order_id LEFT JOIN Member m ON r.member_id = m.member_id LEFT JOIN Partner p ON m.partner_id = p.partner_id LEFT JOIN Warehouse w ON r.warehouse_id = w.warehouse_id WHERE o.approved_order_id = #{approvedOrderId}
mapper.update: UPDATE OutboundOrder SET order_status = #{approvedStatus}, approved_date = NOW() WHERE approved_order_id = #{approvedOrderID}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO Dispatch ( approved_order_id, car_id, car_type, driver_name, assigned_date, dispatch_status, loaded_box, maximum_box ) VALUES ( #{approvedOrderID}, #{carId}, #{carType}, #{driverName}, NOW(), #{dispatchStatus}, #{loadedBox}, #{maximumBOX} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE car_id = #{carId}, car_type = #{carType}, driver_name = #{driverName}, assigned_date = NOW(), dispatch_status = #{dispatchStatus}, loaded_box = #{loadedBox}, maximum_box = #{maximumBOX}
